classification.difficultyReason: Same structure as p38-q13. Convert the bearing to a 50° angle, resolve the westward component, add the second leg. Blank compass supplied.

content.prompt:
A boat sails on a bearing of $230^\circ$ for $85\text{ km}$ then sails due west for $60\text{ km}$.
How far west (to the nearest kilometre) has the boat travelled from its starting point?

answer.worked:
The first leg is $230^\circ-180^\circ=50^\circ$ west of south. In the right-angled triangle, let $x$ be its westward distance.
$$\begin{align*}\sin 50^\circ &= \frac{x}{85}\\x &= 85\sin 50^\circ\end{align*}$$
The total westward distance is
$$\begin{align*}d &= 85\sin 50^\circ+60\\d &\approx 125\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
